deviations.finding: All 365 source day-ending rows use 00:00 with the preceding recorded day, after that day 23:45. Source order is not strictly increasing under literal timestamps.
deviations.decision: Retain raw timestamps and condition time-based forecasts on a declared, neighbor-checked day-end interpretation. Do not sort or overwrite measurements.
deviations.retained_initial_attempt: The initial run completed the turbine calculation then stopped at the strict steel-clock guard; no steel model had been fitted. The original gas parameters remain unchanged.

deviations.finding: The installed pandas/NumPy combination warned on a generic-unit Timedelta constructor. Warnings-as-errors stopped the run before steel fitting.
deviations.decision: Use integer seconds with an explicit unit in the declared midnight interpretation. Preserve the partial completed turbine evaluation in retained_experiments.

deviations.finding: One pinned Scenario B advanced-phase column contains a fractional value 0.5, despite the documented integer phase vocabulary. The strict schema guard stopped the run.
deviations.decision: Preserve the unrecognized phase verbatim and flag it as unsuitable for phase truth; applications can request strict rejection. The frozen benchmark uses the separate valid binary common label and does not round or reinterpret phases.

deviations.finding: The Scenario A operating-point 007 second evaluation CSV contains TRUE/FALSE tokens in the M103 mass-flow field. These are not physical numeric flow measurements.
deviations.decision: Keep raw cells unchanged. The numeric view explicitly flags malformed cells and represents them as unknown; no boolean-to-zero conversion, interpolation or row deletion. Unknown positive-label samples and measurement coverage are reported separately.
